findings.title: Microsoft RPC Endpoint Mapper Exposed
findings.description: MSRPC can be queried to enumerate network services, user accounts, and system interfaces.
findings.remediation: Block Port 135 at network perimeter firewalls and restrict access to authorized management subnets.

findings.title: Server Message Block (SMB) Exposed
findings.description: SMB file sharing services are frequent targets for lateral movement and wormable exploits.
findings.remediation: Disable SMBv1, enforce SMB signing/encryption, and isolate Port 445 behind a firewall or VPN.

findings.title: DNS Service Detected
findings.description: Publicly accessible or misconfigured DNS servers can be leveraged in DNS amplification attacks.
findings.remediation: Ensure DNS recursion is restricted to trusted internal clients only.
